messages.author: af2b60295205d4cb
messages.subject: Re: my shinyapp is totally functional when ran locally, but gives me error message
parts:
I might not offer the full solution. But I wanted to make a comment, that I had an issue when working with shinyapps.io, when I used a method in my code that only worked for Windows environment, like downloading files using a certain function. Shinyapps.io however runs in a Linux (or non-Windows) environment, so my code failed. When I re-wrote my method to work for Macs/Linux, it worked ok (now it wouldn't run locally, but I used it as a separate version strictly for Shinyapps.io).

Maybe that doesn't help much, but just keep that in mind, when writing code for Shinyapps.io

Good luck.
